definition: [ כָּמַס ] verb store up (si vera 1.), in Qal Passive participle כָּמֻס Deut 32:34 is not this stored up ( laid up in store ) with me (|| חָתוּם בְּאוֺצְרֹתָ֑י ); but read probably כָנֻס in same. meaning (see כנס , and Dr Deut 32:34 ).
